versions.name: Archery
versions.description: Learn range safety and whistle commands, name the parts of arrow and bow, build or repair arrows, then shoot scored rounds with a recurve, longbow, or compound bow until you hit the qualifying total.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
